description: This file contains functions for collecting, processing, and generating Wi-Fi radio diagnostic statistics, including API implementations, key generation, and cache copying mechanisms.

methods.name: validate_radio_diagnostic_args
methods.description: Validates the radio diagnostic arguments, ensuring they are not NULL and the radio index is within range.

methods.name: generate_radio_diagnostic_clctr_stats_key
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for radio diagnostic collector stats based on arguments.

methods.name: generate_radio_diagnostic_provider_stats_key
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for radio diagnostic provider stats based on configuration.

methods.name: process_radio_diag_stats
methods.description: Allocates and copies radio data into a new buffer for reporting.

methods.name: execute_radio_diagnostic_stats_api
methods.description: Main API to collect radio traffic stats, update data structures, and send events.

methods.name: copy_radio_diagnostic_stats_from_cache
methods.description: Copies radio diagnostic stats from cache into a new allocated buffer for external use.
